channel.title: Makamin News
channel.description: Latest news and developments from Makamin Saudi Holding

item.title: Makamin Saudi Holding Convenes Its First Board Meeting of 2026, Reviews Governance and Regional Cooperation Priorities
item.description: Makamin Saudi Holding Company for Oil & Gas Services convened its first Board of Directors meeting of 2026 in Al Khobar, with the participation of representatives from Kuwaiti energy companies, to review corporate governance priorities, operational efficiency, and regional cooperation opportunities.

item.title: Makamin Saudi Holding Issues Second Notice Calling for Shareholder Information Updates and Enhanced Governance Compliance
item.description: Makamin Saudi Holding Company for Oil & Gas Services has issued its second shareholder information update notice, stating that as of December 3, 2025, no complete updates meeting the applicable regulatory requirements had been received through the designated portal, and urging shareholders to promptly complete the required information and documentation to strengthen corporate governance and protect lawful shareholder rights.

item.title: Makamin Saudi Holding Convenes Extraordinary General Assembly with Major Shareholder Participation
item.description: Makamin Saudi Holding Company for Oil & Gas Services convened its Extraordinary General Assembly with the participation of major shareholders from Saudi Arabia and abroad. The Assembly voted on the first agenda item and deferred the remaining items pending the required alignment, while applying established voting and representation procedures.

item.title: Invitation to Attend the Extraordinary General Assembly Meeting
item.description: The Board of Directors of Makamin Saudi Holding invites shareholders to attend the Extraordinary General Assembly meeting scheduled for August 23, 2025.

item.title: Launch of the Shareholder Information Update Portal – Mandatory Update of Contact and Ownership Information
item.description: Makamin announces the launch of a dedicated Shareholder Information Update page to enhance governance, protect shareholder rights, and ensure accurate ownership records.

item.title: Makamin Saudi Holding Holds General Assembly in the Presence of the Ministry of Commerce
item.description: In a landmark legal and administrative event, Makamin convened its Ordinary General Assembly pursuant to a final and enforceable judgment issued by the Riyadh Commercial Court.

item.title: Official Announcement on the Appointment of a Temporary Judicial Supervisor and the Invitation to Shareholders to Attend the General Assembly Meeting
item.description: A Commercial Court ruling in Riyadh appointed Mr. Adel Ayed bin Dulaim Al-Noub as Temporary Supervisor to convene the General Assembly and enable shareholders to vote on forming a new Board of Directors.
